{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-TEST-20260907-2249-A7KQ9M",
  "department": "CLOTHING",
  "status": "REPAIR",
  "clothing_decisions": {
    "identity_support": "Wardrobe must support the established Inaria identity without redefining age, body proportions, gender presentation, ethnicity, hairstyle, or canonical character version.",
    "canonical_reference_dependency": "Exact clothing compatibility with Inaria cannot be finalized until the canonical identity and hairstyle reference is attached or resolved through GitHub/shared memory.",
    "fit_and_construction": "Use practical, anatomically plausible garments with believable seams, closures, layering, fabric behavior, and clean intersections at neck, shoulders, waist, hips, hands, and feet.",
    "generation_stability": "Prefer simple-to-moderate garment construction, readable silhouettes, limited overlapping layers, and accessories that do not obscure the face, hands, joints, or body landmarks.",
    "seasonal_styling": "Season, occasion, and location may drive temporary wardrobe choices after the canonical reference is confirmed.",
    "footwear": "Footwear may vary by season, occasion, and location; maintain plausible fit, paired shoes, correct scale, and stable foot anatomy.",
    "accessories": "Accessories may vary intentionally but must remain limited, practical, paired where applicable, and clear of facial features, hands, and pose-critical joints.",
    "hair_interaction": "Necklines, collars, hats, hoods, and hair accessories must accommodate the canonical hairstyle without changing its identity-bearing structure.",
    "handoff_readiness": "CLOTHING can provide downstream wardrobe constraints only after canonical identity confirmation; SCENE, POSE_CAMERA, PROMPT, and DIRECTOR handoffs remain conditional."
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Canonical Inaria identity, age presentation, body proportions, skin tone, facial structure, and identity-bearing hairstyle must not be altered by clothing.",
    "No permanent lock on one outfit, shoe, accessory, silhouette, or color unless explicitly required by an approved task.",
    "Garments must not cause anatomy drift, fused or hidden limbs, malformed hands, duplicated footwear, unstable proportions, or severe garment-body intersections.",
    "Clothing must not obscure recognizable facial features or interfere with identity verification.",
    "Wardrobe must use JSON-only department output.",
    "No production assets may be created during this test run.",
    "Any final wardrobe recommendation must remain compatible with the CHARACTER department's locked constraints and REPAIR status."
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Vary clothing by season, occasion, location, color, silhouette, footwear, and accessories while preserving Inaria recognizability.",
    "Use controlled variation across fitted, relaxed, layered, and structured silhouettes without changing body proportions.",
    "Rotate practical footwear types appropriate to context while maintaining paired construction and stable foot anatomy.",
    "Vary accessory presence and color in moderation; avoid stacking complex accessories that reduce generation reliability.",
    "Allow temporary neckline, sleeve, outerwear, and layering changes that accommodate the canonical hairstyle and pose.",
    "Use restrained color variation to prevent wardrobe uniformity without overpowering identity-bearing features.",
    "Maintain diversity gates by avoiding repeated outfit, shoe, accessory, and dominant-color combinations across the dataset."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Character handoff is REPAIR because the canonical Inaria identity specification or GitHub/shared-memory reference was not available for verification.",
    "Exact garment, footwear, accessory, seasonal, and hairstyle-interaction decisions remain unresolved until the canonical reference is attached or resolved.",
    "Because the upstream identity handoff is not PASS, full integration validation of SCENE, POSE_CAMERA, PROMPT, DIRECTOR routing, failover, anatomy, generation stability, diversity gates, and final QA traceability cannot receive PASS.",
    "No production assets were created.",
    "Required repair: provide the canonical Inaria identity and hairstyle reference, then rerun CLOTHING and downstream handoff validation."
  ]
}
